messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

message.reasoning: The user wants to calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using temperature and volume. They have provided temp in Celsius? They say 300°C and 350°C. But the function expects temp in Kelvin. So we need to convert Celsius to Kelvin. Also volume in m^3. They want three conditions: 2.5 m^3 at 300°C, 2.5 m^3 at 350°C, 1.5 m^3 at 300°C? Actually they said "I will repeat the experiment at higher temperature 350°C, then at lower volume 1.5 m^3 next repeat the experiment." So likely they want: 2.5 m^3 at 300°C, 2.5 m^3 at 350°C, 1.5 m^3 at 300°C. Or maybe 1.5 m^3 at 350°C too? The wording: "I will repeat this experiment at higher temperature 350°C, then at lower volume 1.5 m^3 next repeat the experiment." It could mean they will do 2.5 m^3 at 300°C, 2.5 m^3 at 350°C, 1.5 m^3 at 350°C. But they didn't specify temperature for the lower volume experiment. They said "next repeat the experiment" implying same temperature? Hard to parse. We can ask clarifying question. But we can also interpret as they want all combinations: 2.5 m^3 at 300°C, 2.5 m^3 at 350°C, 1.5 m^3 at 300°C, 1.5 m^3 at 350°C. But they only asked for three different conditions. So maybe they want 2.5 m^3 at 300°C, 2.5 m^3 at 350°C, 1.5 m^3 at 300°C. Let's ask clarifying question.
